title: Canonical finite trace presentation from an ordinary square
statement: Let R be a commutative condensed ring object, A a finite commutative ring, l a prime, r>0, and assume l^r annihilates A. Let Y be Noetherian with l^r invertible, L a family of internal R modules, d a Diagram, and eY,eP finite realizations on Y and P=ProjectiveLine Y [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization]. Supply a FiniteOrdinaryPushSquare for q:P→Y [def-diagonal-finite-ordinary-comparisons]. Then there is a FiniteTracePresentation [def-diagonal-finite-arrow-equations] at N=l^r: a finite q_* right-derived model identified with geoP1Pushforward and normalized by its full cochain unit, a derived square with the supplied underlying normalization, and a positive unit/Chern splitting whose hom is geoP1TwistedMap.

proof.text: Use canonicalDiagonalRightDerived for ordinary finite q_*. Its functor is definitionally geoP1Pushforward. The full canonical-unit equation is composition with the identity at every complex.
Apply diagonalExactSquare_exists to eP.F and eY.F and the supplied ordinary square. Retain the supplied underlying normalization to construct FinitePushSquare.
Apply geoP1Cohomology at exponent r with A and its given annihilator. Its Y component gives the positive splitting and exactly its prescribed hom. Insert these data into FiniteTracePresentation.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteTracePresentation_exists
    (R : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R]
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (l : ℕ) (hl : l.Prime) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hA : ((l ^ r : ℕ) : A) = 0)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (hY : IsUnit ((l ^ r : ℕ) : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules R X) (d : Diagram R Y L)
    (eY : FiniteRealization R A Y) (eP : FiniteRealization R A (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (ordinarySquare : FiniteOrdinaryPushSquare R A (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) eP eY) :
    Nonempty (FiniteTracePresentation R A (l ^ r) (pow_pos hl.pos r) hA Y hY L d eY eP)
